review.page_number_basis: One-based PDF pages; the reviewed pages after the title also display matching page numbers.

observations.claim: The table has 21 data rows, including one unknown entry. It pairs manuscript shapes with transliteration labels and proposed sound values.
Some values depend on position and neighboring sounds. These include initial g, positional h functions, and the shape discussed at the end of page 12.
The m label has a possible initial n value. The author says more examples are necessary to assess this possibility.
The f76r discussion gives a partial opening gloss and a qualified interpretation about pronunciation. The reference to Goths is an assumption.
The author says other content words lack obvious Germanic matches and that English translation would be too speculative.
The author leaves some assigned letter values uncertain and exact word meanings unresolved.

review.interpretation: A real proposed table and some context rules are available. The selected pages do not establish independently validated continuous text.
limits: No equivalents assigned in the Extensible Voynich Alphabet (EVA), a transcription system for written shapes.
Sound-value uncertainty alone does not disprove a fixed sign-to-label map.
No claim about rules or validation on pages outside the detailed selection.
Historical linguistic and dating claims were not validated.
No later website method was examined.
No new manuscript decoding or model fit.

separate_AI_table_review.limit: The other AI reader left several handwritten labels unclear. This is source inspection, not scholarly validation of the proposed reading.

decision: Preserve the candidate table and its limits. No validated key or translation resulted.
